description: This file is a header file for the PTM driver related to the MIPS architecture, defining core functions, data structures, constants, and external references for the ADSL implementation in the UEIP project.

classes.name: ptm_itf
classes.description: Data structure representing a PTM interface with descriptors, statistics, and napi structure.

classes.name: ptm_priv_data
classes.description: Data structure holding private data for the PTM driver, including interface array, IRQ, and descriptor bases.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_get_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version (major and minor).

methods.name: ifx_ptm_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the PTM chip with the given platform device.

methods.name: ifx_pp32_start
methods.description: Starts the PP32 processor with the specified parameter.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_proc_read_regs
methods.description: Reads the PTM registers into a buffer.
